panels.title: Benchmark summary
panels.description: Top-level benchmark outcomes across duration, throughput, and latency.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

panels.title: Benchmark duration (ms)
panels.description: Wall-clock benchmark duration by adapter and scenario.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({

panels.title: Throughput (queries/sec)
panels.description: Observed query throughput over time.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "e2e_latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> toFloat()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> window(every: 5m)
  |> quantile(q: 0.99, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

panels.title: End-to-end latency P99 (ms)
panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end request latency.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "p99_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["query_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"]
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend", "_time"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

panels.title: Query latency P99 — by query (ms)
panels.description: Per-query P99 latency to highlight slow or regressing queries.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "query_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - " + r["scenario"],
      _value: 1 - r._value
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])
